name: Catalan's conjecture and related Diophantine equations
name_zh: 卡塔兰猜想及相关丢番图方程
informal: 对正整数 a、b、c，方程 a·x^n − b·y^m = c 在 x、y > 1 且 (m, n) ≠ (2, 2) 时只有有限多组正整数解 (x, y, m, n)。
informal_en:
For positive integers a, b, and c, there are only finitely many positive solutions (x, y, m, n) to the
equation $ax^n - by^m = c$ where $(m, n) \neq (2, 2)$ and $x, y > 1$.
